title: R package DESCRIPTION declares no licence
description: DESCRIPTION declares a DESCRIPTION that records no licence. Redistribution rights cannot be established from the package metadata, which blocks release review and downstream use.
remediation: Declare the licence exactly as CRAN expects it.
limitation: It matches a DESCRIPTION that records no licence in the parsed DESCRIPTION; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
